method: Four retained unmodified 1280x720 native FightEngine screenshots visually inspected alongside recorded drawImage matrices and real projectile spawn positions.
observations: Walter and Eddie remain complete and legible in both orientations.
The existing white projectile effect aligns with the barrel axis and is one normal 12-world-pixel movement step beyond the muzzle in the active screenshot.
The former 40/60-world-pixel downward offset is absent in the inspected scenes.
The opposite side uses the existing engine mirror; it is not a second source view.
